title: New Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central pricing effective October 2025 (First price increase)
summary: Microsoft announced the first Dynamics 365 Business Central price increase in over five years, effective October 1, 2025. The pricing affects new subscriptions and renewals after that date, with corresponding increases to storage entitlements per license tier.
key_points: First price increase for Business Central in more than five years, taking effect October 1, 2025
Storage entitlements increased: Essentials from 2GB to 3GB, Premium from 3GB to 5GB, Device from 1GB to 1.5GB per user
Pricing applies to new subscriptions immediately and to existing subscriptions upon renewal after October 1, 2025
Team member and additional capacity license prices remain unchanged according to available information
Partners should notify affected customers and projects before the price change takes effect

quotes.text: Microsoft are announcing the first price increase for Dynamics 365 Business Central in more than five years.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the significance and rarity of this pricing action, occurring for the first time in over five years

quotes.text: To coincide with the price increase, Microsoft are increasing the storage entitlement included with each per user license.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows that the price increase is paired with increased value through higher storage allocations across all license tiers

quotes.text: The updated prices apply to new subscriptions and to existing subscriptions upon their first renewal on or after October 1, 2025.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the effective date for both new and existing customers, helping with transition planning
